cues: Welcome to Class 12 Chemistry, Unit 2: Ionic Equilibrium.
It is the longest and most examined unit in physical chemistry.
Acids and bases, the pH scale, solubility products, buffers, indicators and salt hydrolysis.
Almost all of it rests on one idea: reversible reactions between ions, sitting in equilibrium.
